units.source_text: 元旦之晨，源氏公子照例先向桐壶上皇拜年，然后赴今上朱雀帝及东宫太子处，最后来到左大臣邸。

en.t: On the morning of New Year's Day, Prince Genji first paid his customary New Year respects to the retired Emperor Kiritsubo, then went to the reigning Emperor Suzaku and the Crown Prince, and finally arrived at the Left Minister's residence.

units.source_text: 左大臣顾不得新年忌讳，还是和家人闲谈葵姬在世时的往事。

en.t: The Left Minister, unable to mind the New Year's taboos, still talked idly with his family about the days when Lady Aoi was alive.

units.source_text: 正在这时候，源氏公子来了。
左大臣再三隐忍，终难抑制，不禁悲从中来。

en.t: The Left Minister tried again and again to restrain himself, but at last he could hold back no longer, and grief welled up within him.

units.source_text: 源氏公子加了一岁，增了威严，长得比以前越发漂亮了。

en.t: Prince Genji had grown a year older, gained in dignity, and become even more beautiful than before.

units.source_text: 他从左大臣室中退出，便来到葵姬旧居的室中。

en.t: After withdrawing from the Left Minister's room, he went to the chamber that had once been Lady Aoi's residence.

units.source_text: 众侍女热诚欢迎，然而忍不住掉下泪来。

en.t: The ladies-in-waiting welcomed him warmly, yet they could not help shedding tears.

units.source_text: 他看看小公子夕雾，但见这婴儿已经长大得多，时时向人微笑，非常可爱。

en.t: He looked at the young prince Yugiri and saw that the baby had grown a great deal, often smiling at people and looking very endearing.

units.source_text: 口角眼梢，异常肖似东宫太子。

en.t: The corners of his mouth and the ends of his eyes bore an extraordinary resemblance to the Crown Prince.

units.source_text: 源氏公子看了，心中隐痛，他想：“外人见了能不怀疑？”

en.t: Seeing this, Prince Genji felt a hidden pain in his heart and thought, "Could outsiders see him and not become suspicious?"

units.source_text: 房间里一切布置装饰，都与葵姬生前无异。

en.t: Every arrangement and decoration in the room was just as it had been while Lady Aoi was alive.

units.source_text: 衣架上和往年一样挂着新装。

en.t: New garments hung on the clothing stand just as they had in previous years.

units.source_text: 只是没有女装，不免美中不足。

en.t: Only the absence of women's garments left an unavoidable sense that something was missing.
